summary: Describes the standardization cooperation between IEEE Project 802 and the IETF. It was developed jointly by authors from both groups and approved by the IEEE 802 Executive Committee. It replaces RFC 4441.

eli5.summary: Two groups build the pieces of networks. One makes the cables and wireless parts, the other makes the rules above them. This explains how the two groups work together.

questions: how do ieee 802 and the ietf work together
